# package fxcmid

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/uafx/fxcmid"
```

Package fxcmid holds the numeric identifiers of the nodes of the UAFX ConnectionManager information model of OPC 10000-81 (opc.ua.fx.cm.nodeset2 of the OPC Foundation), generated from schema/opc.ua.fx.cm.nodeset2.csv by go generate (internal/cmd/gen).

The identifiers belong to the namespace NamespaceURI. Its namespace index differs from server to server: resolve it with the NamespaceArray of the server, for example ua.NewNumericNodeID(ns, fxcmid.ConnectionManagerType).

## Constants

```go
const NamespaceURI = "http://opcfoundation.org/UA/FX/CM/"
```

NamespaceURI is the namespace of the UAFX ConnectionManager information model.
